name: fabioaacarneiro/sfphp-framework
description: A full-stack PHP framework with zero runtime dependencies, complete async/await system using PHP Fibers, reactive components, and real-time capabilities.

scripts.lint: find app src public tests tools resources -type f -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l && php -l server.php && php -l sfphp

suggest.ext-mbstring: Improves Unicode case conversion; the framework falls back to ASCII folding without it.
suggest.ext-redis: Enables the Redis cache and queue drivers.
suggest.ext-pcntl: Enables graceful shutdown of the queue worker.
suggest.ext-fileinfo: Reads an uploaded file's real media type. Without it assertType() refuses rather than guessing.
suggest.ext-curl: Required by the HTTP client. Without it, Http::get() and friends refuse rather than degrade.
